## Summary

I implemented F004 as a new "What Now" dashboard page that consumes the F001 ActionItem cache (`dashboard/state/what-now.json`) and renders gates needing approval, blocking/needs-setup capabilities, reconcile drift, active supervisors, and architecture staleness as a first-viewport, read-only operating surface. The pure transformation layer is `dashboard/lib/what-now-logic.js` (four-band taxonomy, deterministic band > source > id sort, missing/quiet/populated render branches) with the thin IIFE page module at `dashboard/pages/what-now/what-now.{js,css}`; I wired it into `dashboard/core.js` as the first registered page (default tab on load) and the first aliased loader pulls `state/what-now.json` into `state.whatNow`. The view is strictly read-only — commands are copy-only `<pre><code>` blocks with a non-mutating `navigator.clipboard.writeText` copy button, no drag/drop, no kanban, asserted by the test suite.
